transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, my name is Wei. Could I get your account number and PIN to pull up your account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Wei, sure, account is 396-518-742, PIN 4405. This is Diane Foster.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks Diane, that matches, you're verified. How's your day going so far?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Pretty good, just trying to get this new gadget set up before I head out.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's get that sorted quickly for you then. What can I help with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I just got a smart plug and I can't get it to connect in the app, it keeps failing to find my WiFi.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it, so the new smart plug isn't showing up or connecting when you try to add it in the app. Let's figure out why. Quick question first: when you're setting it up, are you connecting it to your regular WiFi network, or do you have a separate 5 gigahertz network listed too?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I think I've been picking the 5 gigahertz one actually, since that's usually the faster one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's actually the likely cause, a lot of smart home devices like plugs and bulbs only support the 2.4 gigahertz band, they can't join a 5 gigahertz network at all, so it just fails silently like you're seeing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, I had no idea there was a difference for something like this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's a common mix-up. Let's get it connected on the 2.4 gigahertz network instead, that should take about two minutes. Can you open the app and start the setup again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, starting it now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When it asks you to pick a network, look for the one without '5G' or '5GHz' in the name, that'll be the 2.4 gigahertz one.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, found it, selecting that one now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's connecting... okay, it just showed as added successfully.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's great, let's confirm it's actually online. Can you try turning it on and off from the app?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, trying now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yep, the light on the plug just switched off and back on when I tapped it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that confirms it's fully connected and responding. So to recap, the plug only supports 2.4 gigahertz, and picking the 5 gigahertz network was what caused the setup to fail each time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes total sense, thank you for catching that so quickly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If I get more of these plugs later, should I expect the same thing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Most smart plugs and similar devices are 2.4 gigahertz only, so yes, worth picking that network by default when you're setting up any new smart home device going forward.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, that'll save me some frustration next time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does this affect my other WiFi devices at all, or is it just specific to the plug?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No impact on anything else, your laptop and phone can still use either band, it's really just simpler smart home devices limited to 2.4 gigahertz.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Glad that helps. Anything else I can help you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's it, thank you so much Wei.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you so much, Diane. We do value your feedback, so please stay on the line after this call for a short survey. Thank you for choosing S-Net, have a great rest of your day.
